task: Research menu/UI design for Concrete Dragon
resume_brief: Research menu and UI design from Nintendo games (Mario, Zelda, Sunshine, SA2, Luigi's Mansion) and fighters (Street Fighter, Tekken): paged menus vs scrolling, menu art styling, fonts, text boxes, transitions, sound design. Owner hates vertical scrolling menus — wants pages (page 1/2/3) or horizontal. Produce concrete menu redesign plan for Concrete Dragon mapped to the actual game code. Write to ~/workspace/concrete-dragon-launch/research/menu-ui-redesign.md. Sourced facts only, no invention.
